title: Origin story: Thor
description: Thor was the son of Odin and the earth goddess Jord, the strongest of all the Aesir. He dwelt at Thrudheim with his wife Sif of the golden hair, and spent his days riding his goat-drawn chariot across the sky, hunting the giants who threatened the ordered world.

title: Ability profile: Thor
description: Ranked abilities: Superhuman strength — rank 100/100; Hammer combat — rank 100/100; Giant-slaying — rank 99/100; Endurance — rank 97/100; Storm command — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Thor
description: Powers: Mjolnir, the hammer that never misses and always returns; The belt Megingjord, doubling his already vast strength; Lightning and thunder at his call.

title: Stamina feats: Thor
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought giants daily for ages without rest; At Ragnarok will slay the world-serpent before falling.

title: Crossover notes: Thor
description: Thor crosses naturally with: thunder, strength, protection of gods and men.

title: Cultural impact: Thor
description: Thursday is his day; his hammer is the most recognized mythic weapon on earth.

title: Generator record: Thor
